name: Ashuu Yuuta
source:
Innocent, energetic, and optimistic. Because he keeps his smile even in the most difficult situations, most people always think he's happy. In reality, he's always watching the other members and sometimes makes point-blank statements that surprises everyone around him.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/#ashuyuta]official website[/url]]
